record.paper: On graph classes with constant domination-packing ratio

dossier_meta.paper: On graph classes with constant domination-packing ratio
dossier_meta.statement_text: Characterize those graph classes $\mathcal{G}$ for which there is a constant $c_{\mathcal{G}}$ such that $\dfrac{\gamma(G)}{\rho(G)}\leqslant c_{\mathcal{G}}$ for each $G\in\mathcal{G}$.
dossier_meta.context_text: In the conclusion, after extending both the list of graph classes with bounded $\gamma/\rho$ ratio and those with unbounded ratio (notably showing 2-degenerate graphs have bounded ratio), the authors note that Theorem 6.1 on 2-degenerate graphs rules out any characterization purely in terms of sparse graph classes.
